boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named stops on the College Street, West 23rd Street, and University Avenue corridors beside or near UNI.

cards.title: Sidecar Coffee
cards.subtitle: College Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk the College Street corridor to 2215 College Street for a coffee shop with baked treats and simple breakfast.
cards.short_summary: A College Hill café a few steps from UNI.
cards.evidence_claim: Sidecar’s official page places its College Hill café at 2215 College Street and lists coffee, fresh-baked treats, and simple breakfast.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists daily hours; check the page before visiting.

cards.title: Great Wall Chinese Restaurant
cards.subtitle: College Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the College Street corridor to reach 2125 College Street when you want to order from a Chinese restaurant menu.
cards.short_summary: A named Chinese restaurant on College Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Great Wall’s official site identifies the restaurant at 2125 College Street in Cedar Falls and provides its menu and ordering contact.
cards.access_notes: The official site lists hours and a phone number; confirm availability before going.

cards.title: Mohair Pear
cards.subtitle: College Street corridor
cards.notes: Stop at 2209 College Street to browse the shop associated with the Pear Fair’s handmade-gift and artist showcase.
cards.short_summary: A College Street shop tied to a local handmade-goods fair.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pear Fair’s official site identifies Mohair Pear at 2209 College Street and says the fair began to introduce customers to artists whose handmade gifts the store carried.
cards.access_notes: Check the shop and event pages for current availability and event details.

cards.title: College Hill Barber Shop
cards.subtitle: College Street corridor
cards.notes: Head to 2216 College Street if you need a barber-shop appointment along the College Street corridor near campus.
cards.short_summary: A named barber shop on the College Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: UNI Alumni Association’s business listing gives College Hill Barber Shop’s address as 2216 College Street, Suite A, Cedar Falls.
cards.source_title: College Hill Barber Shop | UNI Alumni Association
cards.access_notes: Contact the business directly to confirm services and appointment availability.

cards.title: Greenhouse Kitchen
cards.subtitle: West 23rd Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk West 23rd Street to 917 W 23rd Street for Greenhouse Kitchen’s College Hill location and its listed food menu.
cards.short_summary: A College Hill food stop on West 23rd Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Greenhouse Kitchen’s official locations page identifies its College Hill location at 917 W 23rd Street in Cedar Falls.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Monday–Saturday hours; verify before visiting.

cards.title: Chad’s Pizza & Restaurant
cards.subtitle: West 23rd Street corridor
cards.notes: Follow West 23rd Street to 909 W 23rd Street for a restaurant listed by Cedar Falls Tourism as Chad’s Pizza & Restaurant.
cards.short_summary: A named restaurant on the West 23rd Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Cedar Falls Tourism lists Chad’s Pizza & Restaurant at 909 W 23rd Street in Cedar Falls.
cards.source_title: Eat and Drink | Cedar Falls Tourism
cards.access_notes: Confirm current hours and ordering options with the restaurant before visiting.

cards.title: The Pear Fair
cards.subtitle: College Street and West 22nd Street corridor
cards.notes: Mark the corner of College and West 22nd Streets for the Pear Fair’s scheduled open-air handmade craft and design event.
cards.short_summary: An annual open-air craft fair beside the College Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pear Fair’s official site schedules its 2026 event in Cedar Falls Municipal Lot G at the corner of 22nd and College Streets.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists the 2026 fair for September 26, 11 a.m.–5 p.m.; check for updates before attending.

cards.title: Hy-Vee at College Square
cards.subtitle: University Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the University Avenue corridor to reach the College Square grocery store at 6301 University Avenue for pantry and produce shopping.
cards.short_summary: A grocery stop at the west end of College Square Mall.
cards.evidence_claim: Hy-Vee’s official store page places its Cedar Falls College Square store at 6301 University Avenue and identifies it as a grocery store.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists daily store hours; confirm holiday hours before a trip.

cards.title: Vinyl Cup Records
cards.subtitle: University Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Take the University Avenue corridor to 6322 University Avenue to browse the record shop’s changing collection and listening-focused space.
cards.short_summary: A record shop on University Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Vinyl Cup’s official Cedar Falls page places the shop at 6322 University Avenue and describes it as a record shop with a curated, changing collection.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists store hours; check it before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Oh My Grill Burgers — Cedar Falls
cards.title: Oh My Grill Burgers
cards.subtitle: University Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Follow University Avenue to 6301 University Avenue, Suite 1200, for the restaurant’s lunch and dinner service.
cards.short_summary: A lunch-and-dinner restaurant on University Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Oh My Grill’s official site identifies its Cedar Falls location at 6301 University Avenue, Suite 1200, and says it serves lunch and dinner.
cards.access_notes: The official page provides day-by-day hours; verify them before visiting.
